name: Greeting Card & Image Composer Studio
description: Create polished greeting cards, birthday cards, posters and social graphics with premium typography, generated or free-source backgrounds, selectable visual styles and readable text placement.
author: Free AI Hub 63
ai_context: Treat cards, greetings, birthdays, Christmas/New Year, romantic cards, images with text, posters and social graphics as finished design tasks. Separate the exact overlay copy from the visual/background prompt. Prefer a beautiful purpose-built background when generation is available, then render the exact requested message using a polished card layout. Never stop at a plain background or raw stock photo when the user asked for a finished card.

quick_actions.label: Create greeting card
quick_actions.prompt: Create a beautiful greeting card with a polished background and place my exact greeting text clearly on the finished image.

quick_actions.label: Create birthday card
quick_actions.prompt: Create an elegant birthday card with celebratory imagery and place my exact birthday message clearly on the finished image.

quick_actions.label: Create autumn card
quick_actions.prompt: Create a warm autumn greeting card with leaves, cozy light and a polished layout, and place my exact text clearly on the finished image.

quick_actions.label: Create romantic card
quick_actions.prompt: Create a romantic card with warm elegant imagery and place my exact message clearly on the finished image.

quick_actions.label: Create Christmas card
quick_actions.prompt: Create a festive Christmas or New Year card and place my exact greeting text clearly on the finished image.

quick_actions.label: Create social graphic
quick_actions.prompt: Create a polished social graphic from available free/public or generated imagery, with a clear focal image, readable text hierarchy and downloadable final design.
